svg.text: A martini glass: chapters, then open
The picture this code drew, run as it is printed
Buttons 1 to 4 under the chart: the chapter.
The bowl: every road appears only at the end.
The stem: each note appears on its own chapter.
Drawn at chapter 4, as it ends.
